style: stylized anime combat, glowing additive sakura (Senbonzakura) over a dark night arena, side-view 2D
dominant_shape: narrow spiralling petal column over a floor glow

beats.name: rise
beats.expect: base glow and first rising petals

beats.name: hold
beats.expect: helix of petals and strands at full height

beats.name: loop
beats.expect: next loop takes over with no visible seam

layer_plan.name: 0:Base glow
layer_plan.role: ground: deep-pink glow under the travelling column

layer_plan.name: 1:Spiral pivot
layer_plan.role: pivot yawing the stream so rising petals trace a helix

layer_plan.name: 1:Spiral pivot/1:Spiral strands
layer_plan.role: shape change: torn strands wrapping the column

layer_plan.name: 3:Flung petals
layer_plan.role: secondary: petals flung off the base as it travels

layer_plan.name: 4:Base pulse
layer_plan.role: ground feedback ring, once per loop

acceptance: Reads as a narrow travelling column, clearly different from the wide Petal Storm
Petals flung off the base trail behind it as it moves
avoid: A tell or release flash (it has none: the wind-up belongs to Akari)
A column wider than about two character widths
